newsitem.title: USA: Final U.S. bill must have $85 bln tax cut - Lott.
newsitem.headline: Final U.S. bill must have $85 bln tax cut - Lott.

text.p: U.S. Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott said any final compromise House-Senate tax bill must include the full $85 billion tax reduction agreed to in a balanced budget deal with the White House.
He also said the Senate would stay in session into the weekend if needed to complete work on its version of the tax bill. The Senate will take up the legislation on Wednesday.

"I will not be happy with any final product that does not have a net $85 billion" cut, Lott told reporters, admitting the Senate Finance Committee bill fell short of that mark due to some last-minute changes.
"I will work back toward a full $85 billion iton tax cuts," he said.
